capture_source: live capture 2026-06-29 via Wireshark; SAP A4H gateway 192.168.88.7:3300 (sapgw00); SM59 type-T dest SAPRFC_TEST; pyrfc/NWRFC oracle registering a PROGRAM_ID
binja_ref: libsapnwrfc.so::RfcRegisterServer::0x77c550 -> CpicConnection::registerAsServer_SM::0x4ff35c -> SAP_CMREGTP3::0x5a7ba1 -> STIRegTp::0x798a70 -> GwIConnect::0x7a0c80 (0x0601 GW_CONNECT, STIInit-family builder 0x5add9d)
notes: Registration request = the SAME 0x0601 GW_CONNECT APPCHDR6 frame the client emits; program_id-independent on the wire.
STIRegTp args: arg1=tpname(PROGRAM_ID, <=64 chars, no '*'), arg2=gwhost(<=2048), arg3=gwserv(non-empty). GwIConnect kind=0xb, proposes codepage '1100'.

PROGRAM_ID is NOT present in this frame in any encoding. 'NWRFC' at payload[48:56] is the fixed partner LU name (UtilCpyUcToNet, STIInit). tpname is conveyed by the follow-up SAP_CMACCPTP3 accept exchange (Wave 2).
RFC marker direction: request payload[78:80]=0xffff; ACK flips to 0x0004 and fills the handle.
Variable session-specific bytes (skipped by compare_bytes): connection handle, local IP / NI hostname / service block, OS user, and the time() ASCII-hex blob at payload[122:138].
Offsets below are FILE offsets (NI 4-byte header included): file_offset = payload_offset + 4.
